messages:
kai: quick heads-up: during onboarding I hit a parity gap between REST and the Go SDK. REST accepts `route_hint` and a couple of routing flags we use in infra, but the Go SDK drops them.

rachel: can you paste a tiny repro? which SDK tag?

kai: sdk-go v0.7.9. repro: curl works and returns model variant X, SDK call returns variant Y (shorter context).

kai: curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"gpt-4o-mini\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"summarize\"}],\"route_hint\":\"low_latency\",\"max_output_tokens\":200}'
```

kai: go SDK (drops route_hint):
```go
client.ChatCreate(ctx, ChatCreateParams{
  Model: \"gpt-4o-mini\",
  Messages: []Message{{Role: \"user\", Content: \"summarize\"}},
  MaxOutputTokens: ptr.Int(200),
})
// no field for RouteHint in SDK struct so it never gets sent
```

omar: ugh. looks like we forgot to add newer router hints to the Go types when we expanded the API. other SDKs have it?

rachel: I just checked python and ts SDKs include `route_hint` and `router_options`. Go missed the recent schema sync.

omar: action: add RouteHint field to ChatCreateParams and ensure serializer emits `route_hint` (snake_case). also add an integration contract test that diffs outgoing JSON vs curl.

kai: also noticed the SDK strips explicit nulls for `max_output_tokens` which matters for the router (null -> let router decide; missing -> use default). that caused our tests to pick different variants.

omar: good catch. serializer behavior must preserve explicit nil vs omitted for marked flags.

rachel: filing a short issue DEVEX-4310 and assigning to @omar. good to include a sample-app patch so newcomers don't get incorrect model choices.

ci-bot: Issue DEVEX-4310 created: \"Go SDK: missing route_hint + null-vs-omitted serializer drift\" assigned to omar. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/DEVEX-4310

omar: plan: 1) add RouteHint to public types 2) update JSON tags to snake_case and preserve null markers for flagged fields 3) add contract tests + a sample-app change recommending explicit flags for now. targeting patch release v0.7.10.

kai: for immediate workaround, sample-app maintainers can pass raw JSON with client.RequestRaw to the /v1/chat endpoint. I'll post a minimal snippet in the sample-app repo.

rachel: reminder to docs: our quickstart snippets currently show camelCase in Go examples (`MaxOutputTokens`) which is fine for struct fields but we need to show server keys in comments or a raw example too. otherwise users copy and assume behavior.

omar: will open PRs: one for code + tests, one for sample-app. tagging docs team to update quickstart.

devex-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-go/pull/212 12 adds route_hint and serializer tests. CI triggered.

kai: thanks all. leaving this thread for sample-app maintainers and docs. will follow up if staging still shows differences after the patch. :thumbsup:
